record_title: Exact identifiability dichotomy and Fisher-correlation floor in the non-spatial Klausmeier model
provenance: A source-specific identifiability and inverse-geometry analysis of the non-spatial Klausmeier model studied in arXiv:2609.18231v1.
limitations: Exact trajectory recovery assumes continuous full-state observations with positive biomass. The Fisher-correlation floor is a local equilibrium result for independent isotropic Gaussian state noise and does not determine finite-sample Bayesian performance or the spatial Klausmeier PDE.
